checks.detail: Recomputed raw, normalized response, source package, stats reference and search-evidence file SHA-256; all equal actual capture metadata. No historical prose or score was authored or edited by reviewer.
All seven unique Markdown source URLs in the actual full manuscript were opened and their relevant primary passages or official article abstracts read; each is represented under checkedSources.

23 CE, Wang Feng/Wang Chang guarding, 13-rider breakout, relief recruitment, initial thousand-plus troops, three-thousand assault, Wang Xun death and simultaneous defenders' contribution match the texts. Fake relief letter is supported; ancient troop numbers and collective kills are appropriately distinguished.

24 CE defeat of Wang Lang, 25 CE accession at Hao and 36 CE fall of Gongsun Shu match annals. Zhu Wei participated in the brother's death plotting, negotiated through Cen Peng and retained office/title after surrender, matching the biography.
Corrected actual ChatGPT sentence now explicitly separates revolt in 建武二年 (26 CE) from the imperial campaign, surrender and execution in 建武三年夏 (27 CE), matching the Cen Peng biography.

39 CE land/census order, 40 CE Zhang Ji and ten-plus governors imprisoned to death, four-province armed uprisings, mutual denunciation/capture and relocation with land/grain match dated annals. Manuscript does not falsely claim complete local penetration or immediate abandonment of reform.

Official 1990 article abstracts support continued use of meritorious officials, Nanyang preference, supervision/hostages/remote command and staged demobilization. The article correctly rejects universal retirement and identifies its reliance on public abstracts.

30 CE reduction of 400-plus counties, 45 CE declined western protectorate request, Guo marriage in 24 CE, replacement in 41 CE and Liu Qiang's requested withdrawal/Liu Yang's accession as heir in 43 CE are supported by the relevant entries.
